prompts.prompt:
Create a realistic, production-quality Russian desktop web application UI concept, a SINGLE coherent screen, target dimensions 1440 x 1024. This is a NEW tab "Инструменты" inside the existing Svoboda Mysli mortgage calculator. Use the attached screenshot as actual brand and product reference: white and pale lavender #ECE8EF, cobalt #355DB3, ink #141414, restrained apricot #FFD8BE, pill buttons, Onest body font, Unbounded compact headings, the small Svoboda Mysli logo top right. Refine typography and layout for a serious editable table, readable Russian Cyrillic, 14–16px body, no tiny walls of text, no stock photos, no decorations, no charts, no KPI dashboard. Do not reproduce the calculator form in the reference; redesign the NEW tools tab.
User: real-estate sales staff updating sales tools and preparing a partner PDF. Core: ONE shared editable table, with separate project columns "ДА1", "ДА2", "ДНК-2", never three disconnected project pages. All project-specific conditions and combination rules editable. Existing global calculator navigation remains "Ипотека", "Рассрочка", "ЧПВ", "Траншевая ипотека", selected "Инструменты". Six tool categories: "Ипотека", "Рассрочка", "Дофинансирование ПВ · ЧПВ", "Скидки и акции", "Дополнительные инструменты", "Условия бронирования". Tranche programs belong inside mortgage. NO columns or fields named "Ценность" or "Срок". Loan durations and payment dates may appear inside actual conditions when useful, but no old expiration column. Keep named categories visible through a section index or compact collapsed sections; only one or two categories expanded. Main table structure "Инструмент" then three project columns; each cell contains main terms and a short "Сочетание с акциями" line or clearly readable small selector. No PIF.
Essential controls: "+ Добавить инструмент", "PDF для партнёров", project filter showing all three. Editable state via selected cell/pencil/inspector. Tiny contextual copy explains "Сохранённые условия используются в калькуляторах" or a corresponding precise update action. Allow staff or automation to add a typed program, not merely arbitrary free text. No visible API, JSON or technical robot controls. No send-to-partners action, only PDF export. Partner PDF hides editor controls and internal bank commissions. Optional distinct editor vs partner mode is allowed.
Accurate sample content for showing design, not current advice: DA1 equal installments "ПВ от 30% · равные платежи", "до 20.03.2027", combination "Скидка на сумму ПВ"; DA2 equal "ПВ от 30% · на 24 месяца", same combination; DNK equal row absent marked "—". Fixed monthly installment DA1 "ПВ 10% · от 50 000 ₽/мес.", "Скидка 6%"; DA2 "ПВ 10% · от 50 000 ₽/мес.", "Без скидки"; DNK "20/20 · ПВ 20% · 20 000 ₽/мес.", "4% + 2% на старте". Distinct DNK "4/25" row, DA cells "—", DNK "4 платежа по 25%", "7% + 2% на старте". DA parental "ПВ 20,1% · 3 или 6 месяцев"; DNK "ПВ 20% · до 9 месяцев". Mortgage examples "Субсидированная ипотека", "Сбербанк", "Ставки по программе" rather than invented generic rates. Booking DA1/DA2 "15 000 ₽ · 10 дней" or "50 000 ₽ · месяц"; DNK "15 000 ₽ · 10 дней". Paid booking not a deadline column. Discount for full payment DA "до 13%"; DNK "14% + 5% на старте". Samples may be shortened to fit; don't force every detail or category into big panels. Today is 6 November 2026, Ekaterinburg; if shown use "6 ноября 2026". Small "Макет интерфейса" label distinguishes concept from verified financial offer.
Focus on hierarchy, balanced whitespace, alignment and subtle row separators over boxes nested in boxes. ONE screen per image, no collage, no device/browser chrome, no external concept titles, no option numbering. Natural typography, no warped text. Specific layout direction follows.
Concept direction: COMPARISON LEDGER. Broad full-width table on a pale lavender canvas, maximally close to the existing calculator's identity but refined. No sidebar. Compact masthead with logo and five calculator navigation tabs. Title Инструменты, short subtitle Одна таблица для трёх проектов, primary Добавить инструмент at upper right and quieter PDF для партнёров. A single continuous white rounded table surface, no inner card grid. Header Инструмент | ДА1 | ДА2 | ДНК-2. Slim full-width accordion category bands: mortgage collapsed, Рассрочка expanded with 3 well-spaced rows, ЧПВ collapsed, discounts collapsed, additional tools collapsed, booking collapsed. In monthly payment DA1 cell show blue focused outline and tiny pencil, concise value lines; unobtrusive inline dropdown Сочетание с акциями → Последовательно under that cell; each project has its own combination rule rather than one global column. A slim bottom save bar with Сохранить изменения and quiet Изменения попадут в калькулятор рассрочки. Visually emphasize confident horizontal alignment, large white space between category groups and 16px legible table text. Keep page width 1440 and height1024, fit all content naturally; limit expanded content to 3 rows. One cohesive business document, not a spreadsheet clone or dashboard.
